heading: বাংলাদেশের স্বাধীনতা : কূটনৈতিক যুদ্ধ
content_markdown:
১০৫. ঐ, পৃ. ১৭২
১০৬. Bangladesh Documents. Vol-2, External Affairs Government of India, p. 550)

> দেখুন- Statment by Prime Minister Indira Gandhi in Parliament on Pakistan Army's Surrender in Bangladesh. December 16, 1971. "We hope and trust that the Father of this new nation, Sheikh Mujibur Rahman, will take his rightful place among his own people and lead Bangla Desh to peace, progress and prosperity. The time has come when they can together look forward to meaningful future in their Sonar Bangla. They have our good wishes. The triumph is not theirs alone. All nations who value the human spirit will recognise it a significant milestone in man's quest for liberty."

১০৭. Bangladesh Documents Vol. II. Letter from the Govrnment of Bangladesh to Prime Minister of India November 23, 1971 Mujib Nagar. pp. 583-586.
